senses.gloss: ch. = h.דָּאַג , to be anxious, troubled. Part. דָאִיג, דָּיֵיג.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 156b:4">Sabb. 156ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה דְאִיגָא וכ׳</he> she was very much troubled over it.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:12">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>הוו קא דַיְיגֵי רבנן</he> the rabbis were troubled (over R. Huna’s sudden death).
